notes.title: 25/10 Patch Notes
notes.content: This update includes now content for the game including dynamic dialogue options as well as many other UI and accessibility related fixes.

notes.title: Playtest Update #4
notes.content:
In this update I have fixed all the reported bugs in the period between now and Update #3.
Please report anything you find using the bugs discussion page.

Many thanks,
Oliver

notes.title: Playtest Fix Patch #3
notes.content:
Fixes to many aspects of the game as highlighted via playtest and demo comments including:
Removal of camera shake when jumping.
Removal of damage text artefacts when viewing inventory.
More logging.
Menu Redesign.

notes.title: Playtest Update #2
notes.content:
This build contains improvements and bug fixes highlighted within reviews I have recieved from playtesters. A summary is included below:
- Issues with canvases stacking have been resolved.
- Issues with player movement have been resolved.
- Running, sprinting and attacking on the move.
- NPC health bar fixes and improvements.
